jobs.title: Market Strategy & Planning Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Job Location
HO CHI MINH CITY OFFICE
Job Description

P&G chỉ có thể tiếp tục xử lý hồ sơ ứng tuyển sau khi nhận được sự đồng ý theo yêu cầu. Nếu bạn không đồng ý, P&G sẽ không thể tiếp tục xử lý hoặc xem xét hồ sơ ứng tuyển của bạn cho vị trí này.
----------------------------------------------------------------------

P&G is a leading global consumer goods company whose winning brands are built around the model of innovation. Whatever your passion is, we want to ignite your potential to become your very best self. We hold true to our purpose, values and principles as we seek to make a difference in the world around us. You will engage in meaningful work that will touch the lives of others and have a real impact. Everything at P&G starts with understanding - understanding our consumers and our employees as we innovate to improve lives now and for generations to come.

As a Marketing & Strategy Planning Manager at P&G, you will be one of our key drivers behind our continued growth and success! With our commitment to innovation, it's you who will develop go-to-market commercial plans for the P&G brands for Vietnam Market.

What success looks like
- Search and reapply shown success models with the different regions.

- Create Strong Conceptual Sell for our Field Sales to sell to our customers.

- Build market/regional knowledge by sharing initiative progress and competitive review.

Responsibilities
- Develop winning commercial plans to enable Sales teams to win in stores and drive local Go-to-Market & Sales Fundamentals strategies to win with customers.

- Lead deployment of agreed regional strategies, key business priorities and regional master plan to the Key Account Managers/Market Development Managers.

- Define and deliver regional sales fundamentals and business targets.

- Track promotion efficiency, ROI/cost-event analysis to ensure the best outcome for our in-market investments.

- Contribute to stewardship conformity giving clear mentorship on compliant spending to ensure the best use of budgets and no control outages.

Job Qualifications
- Expertise of operations at 1) Joint Business Planning (JBP) meetings with key customers and 2) the shopper-based design/key sales fundamental (counter location and size) to provide clear guidance to Sales team to drive the best in-store execution.

- Deep understanding of commercial planning and processes.

- Understanding of Vietnam Market through understanding consumers and customers’ needs and wants for the channel and store level.

- Expertise in retail promotion planning and execution to reflect in future planning.

- High proficiency in English and remote communication.

- Proven ability to communicate, present and influence credibly and optimally to external and internal stakeholders.

- Flexibility in field travel

- Exp 3-5 years in Market Strategy and Planning

- E-commerce experience is an advantage

At P&G, we don't just offer a job, we provide a career with diverse assignments and numerous development opportunities to groom our future leaders!

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager (Experienced)
jobs.description:
Job Location
CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES
Job Description
Ready to make an impact with a world-class Finance & Accounting team? Join a global industry leader where your expertise will help shape business decisions, drive growth, and influence the future of our organization.

At P&G, we believe that diverse experiences help build strong leaders. Mobility is a key component of many management careers, providing opportunities to grow through different assignments, locations, and business challenges. Candidates should be prepared to consider relocation opportunities throughout their career as business needs and development opportunities arise.

Finance & Accounting at P&G plays a leadership role in strategy setting, decision-making, business planning and analysis across all aspects of the business. In addition, we lead Company efforts in Tax, Treasury, M&A, Corporate Strategy, Accounting and Internal Controls. You will work as the finance leader on a multi-functional team responsible for a brand, a service, or a key project. Within these teams, you will find tight-knit collaboration among team members and an environment where your perspectives are valued. The focus is to win as a team with strong individual contributions.

Your career is filled with meaningful, and diverse assignments intended to sharpen and expand your functional skills while building out your broader business and leadership skills. We focus on your development. Early in your career, there is a rotational assignment model where employees change assignments every 2 to 3 years. Over the course of your career, you will likely work in all areas including: Brand/Region/Global Business Divisions, Corporate Financial Planning & Analysis, Supply Chain Finance, Sales Finance, Corporate Shared Services Finance and Research & Development Finance. As you progress, you may have the opportunity to work globally – via business travel or to complete a 3 to 4-year assignment in Europe, Asia, Middle East / Africa or Latin America. If you prefer, you may also choose to “specialize” in a certain area like Tax, Treasury, Accounting or Internal Controls. This enables you to become a “subject matter” authority for the Company. We want to build the career path that is right for you.

We are invested in your success. Nearly all Senior Leaders started at entry level. Our “promote from within” approach requires us to do more. Along with meaningful assignments, you will be strongly supported from your manager, mentors and peers. You will receive training to help build your skills beyond what you will learn in your current assignment and to help advance your development as a leader in the company.

We want you to join us for a career and not just an assignment. We value our employee’s well-being and know work-life balance is a critical part of you performing at your peak over the long haul. We offer a compensation package designed to be competitive with the top companies across the US.

Job Qualifications
If   you’re a good fit, you must have:
- Excellent leadership skills.  We are looking for the “very best” with proven track records of success.
- 3+ years of professional work experience.
- A major or concentration in any of these areas – Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business, Commerce, or Taxation

Starting Pay/Salary Range: $110,000 – 165,300

Compensation for roles at P&G varies depending on a wide array of non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, degree/credentials, relevant skill set, and level of relevant experience. At P&G compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Total rewards at P&G include salary + bonus (if applicable) + benefits.  Your recruiter may be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the hiring process.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Immigration Sponsorship is not available for this role. For more information regarding who is eligible for hire at P&G along with other work authorization FAQ’s, please click HERE .

Procter & Gamble participates in E-Verify.

Qualified individuals will not be disadvantaged based on being unemployed.

jobs.title: 経営管理　FP&A
jobs.description:
Job Location
KOBE GO & IC - SANNOMIYA
Job Description
ご応募いただく際は、必ず 中途採用応募手続きガイド を参照の上、ご応募ください。

【仕事内容】
P&Gの経営管理部門（F&A）は、単なる会計・財務機能ではなく、事業成長と企業価値向上を実現する戦略パートナーとして、経営の中核を担っています。株主・経営者の視点に立ち、収益性の高いビジネスモデルの構築、健全な財務戦略の策定、そして長期的な事業価値の最大化を推進することがミッションです。

本ポジションは、担当いただく組織の戦略的なファイナンスビジネスパートナーとして、予算計画、コストマネジメント、および生産性向上施策をリードする役割を担います。

関係部門のリーダーと密接に連携しながら、継続的なコスト削減機会の特定・実現、リソース配分の最適化、および組織全体の生産性向上を推進します。また、財務データに基づく分析と提言を通じて、質の高い意思決定を支援し、持続的な事業成長と企業価値向上に貢献します。
P&Gならではのグローバルなベストプラクティスや標準化されたプロセスに触れながら、ファイナンスの専門性はもちろん、ビジネスリーダーとしての視座と実行力を高めていける環境です。

主な業務内容
- 財務データ並びに社内外の市場データを用いた投資ROI分析・競合分析に基づく戦略提案と実行
- リーダーシップチームに対する、中長期戦略提案
- 継続的にコスト削減の機会を分析し、実現するためにクロスファンクショナルチームをリード
- マルチファンクションチームを巻き込み、経営計画、単年度予算策定の取りまとめ、及びその実行管理
- 財務指標・KPIレポーティング、月次決算対応、コスト配分プロセスの標準化・改善を推進

【このポジションで得られること】
- 経営に近い立場で、担当組織の重要な意思決定に直接関わることができる
- 財務分析にとどまらず、戦略立案から実行推進まで一貫して担当できる
- ブランド、営業、生産、サプライチェーンなど、他職種と連携しながら事業全体にインパクトを与えられる
- グローバル水準の仕組み・知見を活用し、高い専門性とリーダーシップを磨ける
- 入社後早い段階から、大きな裁量とオーナーシップを持って活躍できる

【求める人物像】
- 数字を分析するだけでなく、分析結果をもとに課題を特定し、アクションにつなげられる方
- 多様な関係者を巻き込み、部門横断で物事を推進できる方
- 高い論理性とビジネス感覚を持ち、経営視点で意思決定を支援できる方
- 変化のある環境の中で、自らオーナーシップを持って挑戦できる方

【勤務地】
神戸

【選考プロセス】
1. 書類選考
2. オンラインテスト
3. 個人面接2回程度（オンライン）
*ご応募いただいた方にはオンラインテストのご案内が2-3営業日以内に配信されます。マイページ（候補者ホーム）より テスト配信後 1 週間以内 にオンラインテストを受検ください。受検完了いただいた方より次のステップにお進みいただきます。

【応募方法】
下の応募ボタンを押し、 「手動で応募」 を選択し、次の画面右上で「日本語」を選択後、まずはアカウントを作成して応募手続きください。ご応募の際には、 和文履歴書、和文職務経歴書 を必ずアップロードください。 全てご提出いただいていない場合は次のステップにお進みいただけませんのでご注意ください。

Job Qualifications

-日本語ネイティブレベルもしくは日本語能力試験N1保持者
-TOEIC800点程度以上の英語力
-事業会社における財務計画立案、経営企画、戦略立案、事業計画などの業務経験もしくはコンサルティング会社での業務経験を2~4年程度お持ちの方

jobs.title: Sr Identity & Access Managements Operations Manager - Active Directory
jobs.description:
Job Location
CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES
Job Description
The Operations Manager for InfoSec IAM leads and continuously improves end-to-end service delivery for Identity and Access Management services on a regional and global basis. This role ensures secure, integrated, efficient, and reliable IAM operations that protect company information assets and align IT access with business needs.

Operations Managers are expected to:
- Deliver operational excellence through leveraging different practices such as ITIL and SRE
- Have an in-depth understanding of the service and business, and ensure that the support model and other operational requirements such as SLAs and OLAs meet the customer and partner’s expectations
- Continuously look for opportunities to drive efficiencies through standardization, automation, and simplification
- Lead the crisis management activities for complex and high impact outages.
- Participate in or are accountable for all aspects of service delivery including overall quality of service, service transition, vendor management, and service level management across critical IAM services

Job Description:
The Operations Manager for InfoSec IAM manages key IAM applications, Active Directory platforms, and supporting infrastructure used to enable secure authentication, authorization, and use of Group Policy Objects, as well as critical aspects of Company owned Entra ID. The role requires strong operational leadership, practical technical depth, and the ability to work across engineering, service delivery, vendors, security partners, and business stakeholders to maintain resilient and secure IAM services.

Your Team
This role is part of the InfoSec IAM Operations and supports global Active Directory Services, Entra ID, and related IAM capabilities. The team works across multiple regions and partners closely with Level 2 operations, Level 3 specialists, engineering, product and service owners, vendors, and security stakeholders to deliver stable, secure, and continuously improving IAM operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Lead end-to-end operational service delivery for assigned InfoSec IAM services, ensuring service quality, reliability, security, and compliance with internal standards and business expectations.
- Drive ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and service transition processes, including escalation leadership for complex or high-impact service issues.
- Resolve complex operational problems, improve procedures, and facilitate clear communication across technical teams, service owners, vendors, and business stakeholders.
- Define, monitor, and improve service levels, KPIs, metrics, operational health measures, and action plans that improve service performance and customer experience.
- Continuously identify opportunities to standardize, automate, simplify, and improve IAM operations using practices such as ITIL, SRE, agile, automation, and continuous service improvement.
- Lead or participate as an domain SME in crisis management activities for high-impact outages, ensuring timely coordination, decision-making, stakeholder communication, and post-incident learning.
- Maintain operational documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, training plans, and reports needed to support service quality, compliance, and business continuity.
- Partner with engineering, product owners, solution managers, and security stakeholders to ensure new capabilities are supportable, secure, measurable, and ready for operational transition.
- Provide vendor and partner oversight, ensuring support teams meet service expectations, follow approved processes, maintain documentation quality, and execute work within agreed operating models.
- Keep current on industry’s best practices and adhere to the latest design best practices, strategies, technologies, and industry changes.

Position-Specific Responsibilities
- Active Directory Operations: Oversee operational support, stability, security, hardening, monitoring, backup, auditing, disaster recovery readiness, and other operational aspects for enterprise Active Directory environments.
- Entra ID Operations: Support operational excellence for Entra ID capabilities including enterprise applications, application registrations, service principals, Graph API permissions, Conditional Access, PIM, MFA, Windows Hello for Business, Entra Connect, and identity synchronization.
- Active Directory Services Security: Lead or coordinate remediation of Active Directory security findings, implementation of secure baseline requirements, GPO governance, privileged access controls, Tier model alignment, and ongoing hardening efforts.
- Service Operations and Escalation: Ensure Level 2 and Level 3 teams effectively triage, route, troubleshoot, resolve, and document incidents, requests, and changes in ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.
- Operational Resilience: Ensure appropriate monitoring, alerting, backups, recovery procedures, continuity documentation, and disaster recovery exercises are maintained for IAM-owned services.
- Automation and Process Improvement: Drive automation, scripting, data hygiene, operational reporting, and simplification of recurring operational activities to improve quality, speed, and reliability.
- Change and Release Execution: Plan, approve, coordinate, and validate changes such as platform upgrades, patches, hardening activities, service migrations, tooling transitions, and operational improvements.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work with IAM service owners, engineering, architecture, security operations, application teams, infrastructure teams, vendors, and regional operations teams to deliver best-in-class service outcomes.

Job Qualifications
Required:
- 5+ years of IT experience, with at least 3 years focused within IAM and/or Active Directory, to include but not limited to: - LDAP
- Active Directory Users & Computers
- Domain Controllers
- PowerShell
- GPO
- Windows Server 2019/'22/'25.

- At least 1 year of experience working within an IT Operations focused role - Maintaining and patching servers
- Fulfilling and answering SNOW tickets
- Responding to IT emergencies impacting the business
- Safeguarding availability of AD services to the business
- Defining and executing service improvement ideas/plans
- Tracking & Improving service health metrics

- Able to define strategy and leads the delivery and transformation of business outcomes through IT within major business/organization services, products, or programs.
- Ability to work hybrid schedule in Cincinnati, OH based office.

Preferred:
- Certifications: MS Certified in applicable technology, ITIL V4 or V5, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), CISSP, or any other applicable information security related certifcates.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, or related field.

Job Summary
Are you passionate about sales, building strong business relationships, and turning ideas into results? Join P&G as a Sales Manager in the Traditional Trade Channel , based in Trujillo and responsible for Trujillo and Chimbote.
In this role, you will manage the distributor relationship and guide its sales force to achieve sales targets and drive sustainable growth across our product categories. You will combine data analysis and strategic planning with hands-on field execution—identifying opportunities, developing actionable plans, and following through to ensure results.
This position requires influence and collaboration with the distributor’s sales team rather than direct management of P&G employees. It offers opportunities to develop your commercial and leadership skills while making a meaningful business impact.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage the distributor relationship: Build strong working relationships with the distributor and its sales teams across Trujillo and Chimbote, aligning on sales targets, priorities, and execution plans.
- Develop and execute sales strategies: Translate business objectives and market opportunities into practical plans that drive sales and growth across P&G categories.
- Analyze sales performance: Use sales data and field insights to monitor progress against targets, identify performance gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
- Drive field execution: Conduct regular field visits alongside sellers to understand market dynamics, assess execution, and turn growth opportunities into measurable results.
- Guide and coach the distributor’s sales force: Communicate objectives, provide training, and build credibility through channel knowledge and actionable guidance.
- Follow through on results: Track action plans consistently and adjust strategies based on performance, seller feedback, and market conditions.
- Collaborate and innovate: Listen to the sales team’s ideas, share relevant information, and implement improvements that address local business needs.
- Maintain operational discipline: Organize priorities effectively, learn company processes quickly, and comply with applicable internal policies and stewardship requirements.

Job Qualifications
Required Background
- Bachelor’s degree.
- Relevant sales experience in Traditional Trade and consumer goods , with practical knowledge of distributor operations and field sales.
- Ability to be based in Trujillo, conduct regular field visits, and travel to Chimbote approximately once or twice per month.
- Strong written and spoken Spanish.

Must-Have Skills
- Traditional Trade Expertise
Understanding of channel dynamics, distributor relationships, and sellers’ day-to-day challenges, with the ability to apply that knowledge to commercial decisions.
- Analytical Skills and Practical Excel Proficiency
Ability to analyze sales data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate insights into actions. Comfortable using Excel formulas and lookup functions; macros are not required.
- Strategic Planning and Hands-On Execution
Ability to create actionable sales plans, prioritize effectively, solve problems, and maintain consistent follow-up to deliver results.
- Communication, Relationship Building, and Influence
Ability to communicate clearly, establish credibility, and coach and motivate a distributor’s sales force without relying on direct reporting authority.
- Adaptability, Collaboration, and Initiative
Ability to learn processes quickly, work effectively with people from diverse backgrounds, incorporate team feedback, and proactively bring forward new ideas. Strong motivation to learn and grow within the organization.

Nice-to-Have
- Business or marketing specialization: A degree focused on business administration, marketing, or a related field.
- Sales analytics tools: Familiarity with Salesforce, Tableau, or similar platforms.
- Advanced Excel capabilities: Advanced reporting, automation, or other capabilities beyond the practical analysis required for the role.
- Data visualization: Ability to create clear dashboards and reports that communicate commercial insights.
- Strong English communication skills: Particularly valuable for longer-term career development and future roles, although day-to-day English use in this position is limited.*

What We Offer
- Responsibility from Day 1: Ownership of meaningful commercial priorities and the opportunity to contribute directly to business results.
- Continuous coaching and mentorship: Formal training and ongoing support to strengthen your sales, business, and leadership capabilities.
- Career development: Opportunities to learn through challenging assignments and grow within the organization.
- A dynamic and respectful work environment: A culture grounded in our Purpose, Values, and Principles, where individual contributions and new ideas are valued.
- Competitive compensation and benefits: A package that considers relevant experience under company guidelines.

Are you looking for a Brand Building career where you will have the opportunity to deliver high impact business outcomes? Come to P&G where Brand Management was born! P&G invented the concept of branding and data-driven brand management, and over the years, we have remained consistently among the top in marketing by finding new and exciting ways to reach consumers.

The Opportunity
You will have significant runway to drive new users and accelerated growth with a strong innovation pipeline, seasonals & collaborations, and true Canadian partnerships with high profile brands.  There is opportunity for creative thinking, strategic pivots, and testing & learning to grow these brands double-digits year over year with many opportunities to leave YOUR fingerprints all over these brands.  We are currently recruiting for an open vacancy for Senior Brand Manager to join our organization immediately.

In this role, you will work in an environment that supports your professional growth and celebrates your successes. You can expect mentorship, clear development paths, and a manager who truly cares about your career journey within P&G. As you expand your impact on the business, you can expect to grow through broad, diverse Brand Building experiences with progressive responsibilities.

Ultimately, you will be at the core of breakthrough innovations, be given exciting assignments, lead initiatives, and take ownership and responsibility. You will do this in creative workspaces where new ideas flourish. You will receive world-class training to help you sharpen your craft. And it’s not just about what you will do, but how you will feel: welcomed, valued, purposeful, challenged, and inspired.

The Ideal Candidate Has
- A track record of forward-thinking, strategic, and courageous leadership skills.

- Demonstrated strengths in strategic and analytical thinking.

- An exceptional ability to drive innovation and brand growth.

- An agile mindset with a passion for problem-solving, enabling you to strategically tackle challenging situations in a complex and dynamic business environment.

- Superior communication skills that will enable you to lead the thinking of decision makers internal and external to P&G.

In this role, you will:
- Lead a multi-disciplinary team (including Sales, Finance, Product Supply, Insights, Advertising, and Media/PR Agencies) to develop strategies to grow multi-million dollar brands.

- Lead and execute the go-to-market and consumer insight-led brand plans behind our innovation product launches.

- Be a highly visible business leader for these key brands, working directly with our Regional Business Unit to support growth objectives. You'll also find a collaborative and effective working relationship with our counterparts in the United States, fostering a truly integrated North American strategy.

- Analyze complex data to identify consumer and business insights to enable Brand leaders as they set direction for brand growth.

- Innovate, explore, and test new marketing ideas in an environment where creativity and experimentation are encouraged.

- Manage a significant business, leading a diverse portfolio of strategic projects.

Description du poste
Vous recherchez une carrière dans la création de marque où vous aurez l'opportunité de produire des résultats commerciaux à fort impact ? Venez chez P&G, là où la gestion de marque est née ! P&G a inventé le concept de branding et de gestion de marque axée sur les données, et au fil des ans, nous sommes restés constamment parmi les leaders du marketing en trouvant de nouvelles façons passionnantes d'atteindre les consommateurs.
L'Opportunité
Vous disposerez d'une marge de manœuvre significative pour attirer de nouveaux utilisateurs et accélérer la croissance grâce à un solide pipeline d'innovation, des produits saisonniers et des collaborations, ainsi que de véritables partenariats canadiens avec des marques de premier plan. Il y aura des opportunités de pensée créative, de pivots stratégiques, de tests et d'apprentissage pour faire croître ces marques à deux chiffres d'année en année, avec de nombreuses occasions de laisser VOTRE empreinte sur ces marques. Nous recrutons actuellement pour un poste vacant de Responsable de marque senior pour rejoindre notre organisation immédiatement.
Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez dans un environnement qui soutient votre croissance professionnelle et célèbre vos succès. Vous pouvez vous attendre à un mentorat, à des parcours de développement clairs et à un responsable qui se soucie réellement de votre parcours professionnel au sein de P&G. Au fur et à mesure que vous étendez votre impact sur l'entreprise, vous pouvez vous attendre à évoluer grâce à des expériences de création de marque vastes et diversifiées avec des responsabilités croissantes.
En fin de compte, vous serez au cœur d'innovations révolutionnaires, vous recevrez des missions passionnantes, dirigerez des initiatives et assumerez la propriété et la responsabilité. Vous le ferez dans des espaces de travail créatifs où les nouvelles idées s'épanouissent. Vous recevrez une formation de classe mondiale pour vous aider à perfectionner votre art. Et il ne s'agit pas seulement de ce que vous ferez, mais de ce que vous ressentirez : accueilli, valorisé, utile, mis au défi et inspiré.
Le candidat idéal possède
- Une feuille de route en matière de leadership avant-gardiste, stratégique et audacieux.
- Des forces démontrées en pensée stratégique et analytique.
- Une capacité exceptionnelle à stimuler l'innovation et la croissance des marques.
- Un état d'esprit agile avec une passion pour la résolution de problèmes, vous permettant de gérer stratégiquement des situations difficiles dans un environnement commercial complexe et dynamique.
- Des compétences en communication supérieures qui vous permettront de guider la réflexion des décideurs internes et externes à P&G.

Dans ce rôle, vous allez :
- Diriger une équipe multidisciplinaire (incluant les ventes, les finances, l'approvisionnement en produits, les études de marché, la publicité et les agences médias/RP) pour élaborer des stratégies visant à faire croître des marques de plusieurs millions de dollars.
- Diriger et exécuter les plans de mise sur le marché et les plans de marque axés sur les insights consommateurs derrière nos lancements de produits innovants.
- Être un leader commercial très visible pour ces marques clés, travaillant directement avec notre unité commerciale régionale pour soutenir les objectifs de croissance. Vous trouverez également une relation de travail collaborative et efficace avec nos homologues aux États-Unis, favorisant une stratégie nord-américaine véritablement intégrée.
- Analyser des données complexes pour identifier les insights consommateurs et commerciaux afin de permettre aux leaders de marque de définir l'orientation de la croissance de la marque.
- Innover, explorer et tester de nouvelles idées marketing dans un environnement où la créativité et l'expérimentation sont encouragées.
- Gérer une entreprise importante, en dirigeant un portefeuille diversifié de projets stratégiques.

Qualifications
Qualifications requises :
- Baccalauréat ou diplôme supérieur.
- 3 à 5 ans et plus d'expérience pertinente en gestion de marque.
- Expérience de travail avec des ensembles de données (par exemple : données Nielsen) et capacité à synthétiser des données en stratégies commerciales actionnables.
- Capacité à travailler 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans notre bureau de Toronto.

Qualifications préférées :
- Expérience des biens de consommation emballés.

Chez P&G, nous pensons que les expériences diverses aident à former des leaders solides. La mobilité est un élément clé de nombreuses carrières de gestion, offrant des opportunités de croissance à travers différentes affectations, lieux et défis commerciaux. Job Description
The successful Performance Marketer will plan, execute, and optimize digital media investments to drive measurable business results. This role helps translate brand and customer objectives into disciplined performance marketing plans across paid channels, ensuring campaigns are built correctly, optimized thoughtfully, and stewarded with strong financial and analytical rigour.

In this role, you will:

- Translate business, customer, and campaign objectives into clear digital media plans across channels such as paid social and other performance-oriented environments.
- Manage core executional details of campaigns, including audience setup, asset trafficking, tagging coordination, quality assurance, calendar alignment, and handoff to agency or platform partners as required.
- Monitor campaign performance closely and use data to identify opportunities for optimization in targeting, placements, bids, creative rotation, landing experience, or budget allocation.
- Design and support test-and-learn plans to improve media efficiency and effectiveness, helping the business learn what combinations of audience, message, channel, and asset are driving the best outcomes.
- Own performance tracking, reporting, and insight generation for campaigns, building clear summaries of what is working, what is not, and what actions are recommended next.
- Manage budgets and media stewardship carefully, ensuring investments are tracked accurately, aligned to approved plans, and optimized toward measurable return.
- Partner with brand, sales, content, and analytics teams to ensure digital media plans connect with broader go-to-market strategies and consumer journeys.
- Work closely with agencies and external partners to ensure campaigns are implemented and optimized in line with approved strategy, technical requirements, and business priorities.
- Maintain a strong understanding of performance measurement frameworks, attribution considerations, and platform changes so media decisions remain informed and current.
- Operate with agility across multiple campaigns and stakeholders, balancing strategic thinking with the detailed execution discipline required to keep programs running smoothly.

Le spécialiste en marketing de la performance (Performance Marketer) planifiera, exécutera et optimisera les investissements médias numériques afin de générer des résultats commerciaux mesurables. Ce rôle consiste à traduire les objectifs de la marque et des clients en plans de marketing de la performance rigoureux sur les canaux payants, en veillant à ce que les campagnes soient correctement structurées, judicieusement optimisées et gérées avec une grande rigueur financière et analytique. Dans ce rôle, vous devrez : Traduire les objectifs commerciaux, clients et de campagne en plans médias numériques clairs sur divers canaux, tels que les réseaux sociaux payants et autres environnements axés sur la performance. Gérer les aspects opérationnels clés des campagnes, notamment la définition des audiences, la gestion des actifs (trafic), la coordination du marquage (tagging), l'assurance qualité, la synchronisation des calendriers et la transmission aux agences ou partenaires de plateformes, le cas échéant. Suivre de près les performances des campagnes et utiliser les données pour identifier des opportunités d'optimisation concernant le ciblage, les emplacements, les enchères, la rotation des créations, l'expérience sur les pages de destination ou la répartition budgétaire. Concevoir et soutenir des plans de test et d'apprentissage (« test-and-learn ») pour améliorer l'efficacité et le rendement des médias, aidant ainsi l'entreprise à déterminer quelles combinaisons d'audience, de message, de canal et d'actif génèrent les meilleurs résultats. Prendre en charge le suivi des performances, le reporting et l'analyse des campagnes, en élaborant des synthèses claires sur ce qui fonctionne, ce qui ne fonctionne pas et les actions recommandées pour la suite. Gérer les budgets et la gestion des investissements médias avec soin, en veillant à ce que les dépenses soient suivies avec précision, conformes aux plans approuvés et optimisées pour générer un retour mesurable. Collaborer avec les équipes chargées de la marque, des ventes, du contenu et de l'analyse pour s'assurer que les plans médias numériques s'inscrivent dans les stratégies de mise sur le marché et les parcours clients globaux. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les agences et les partenaires externes pour garantir que les campagnes sont mises en œuvre et optimisées conformément à la stratégie approuvée, aux exigences techniques et aux priorités commerciales. Maintenir une solide compréhension des cadres de mesure de la performance, des enjeux d'attribution et des évolutions des plateformes afin que les décisions médias restent éclairées et actualisées. Faire preuve d'agilité dans la gestion de multiples campagnes et parties prenantes, en conciliant réflexion stratégique et rigueur opérationnelle pour assurer le bon déroulement des programmes.

Expérience préalable en publicité payante, marketing digital, analyse de données, e-commerce ou gestion de campagnes. Sens des affaires Compréhension de l'impact de la publicité payante sur la croissance, les parcours clients, les résultats e-commerce et les priorités commerciales globales. Expertise médias et performance Solide maîtrise des principes de la publicité payante sur les réseaux sociaux, du référencement, du programmatique, du ciblage, de l'optimisation et de la gestion de campagnes. Gestion financière rigoureuse Gestion budgétaire rigoureuse, suivi, prévision des résultats et souci d'un retour sur investissement optimal. Collaboration Capacité à travailler efficacement avec les équipes marque, client, ventes, analyse, finance et agences partenaires dans un environnement matriciel. Maîtrise des outils numériques Aptitude à utiliser les plateformes médias, les outils de reporting, les flux de travail de balisage, les tableaux de bord et la gestion de campagnes. Exploitation des données et analyse Capacité à interpréter les données de performance, à en tirer des enseignements et à les traduire en actions d'optimisation concrètes.

Job Description

YOUR FUTURE EMPLOYER

From its foundation 185 years ago as a soap and candle start-up, P&G today is a leading consumer goods company. We are home to iconic, trusted brands that touch 5 billion consumers worldwide and make life a little bit easier in small but meaningful ways.
Our people are our greatest asset: with our philosophy of promotion from within, we place strong emphasis on employee development and are committed to finding and fostering world-class talent. Learn from our inspiring leaders, shape our supportive and welcoming culture, and place your personal development at the core of your work!

YOUR DOUBLE INTERNSHIP

Are you eager to lead exciting projects and have a meaningful impact with your ideas? Are you interested in shaping retailer partnerships to grow our mutual business, or developing the vision & strategy behind our brands? Our dual internships, focusing on Sales and Brand Management/Marketing, offer the opportunity to do just that!

If you are interested in launching your career as a future business leader, our double Sales & Brand Management/Marketing internship is for you. You will complete an internship comprising a full set of projects in each of our Sales and Marketing functions, each lasting between 3 and 6 months (depending on your choice of total internship duration).

Our internships are suitable for students seeking a gap year between Bachelors & Masters, or within your current degree program.

In Marketing , you might join a project in one of three teams: our Commercial Operations team for a particular brand or category, our Brand Operations team with responsibilities for many categories on a specific marketing touch point, or a Sales team developing marketing plans across categories for a specific retailer.

In Sales , you could be working in one of three teams: Key Account Management, Market Strategy Management, or Category Management. Your projects would include understanding and analyse the business drivers that are important to us and our retailers, creating recommendations, or even working on the launch of new products with our retail partners!

From Day 1, you will receive your own projects to contribute to the team and business that you are working in. Through these you gain insight into how we work and what we do in P&G – and can start to shape your career in our commercial organisation, as we offer full-time employment at the end of studies for all interns who have successfully delivered their projects.
This internship is perfect for you if you are interested to explore both the consumer and retailer side of our business, or would like to use the opportunity to learn in multiple areas before starting a more specialised full-time career. Are you already certain you want to start your career in either Sales OR Marketing? Then apply for the specific internship role to focus in one functional area!

- You are skilled to make complex decisions using all the data available but confident to use your gut feeling and instinct.

- You are familiar with the DACH market and its retail & consumer landscape.

- Short work experience, or internships and studies abroad, are considered as a plus.

- A   competitive internship salary (monthly 2,600€).

- Wide range of social benefits:  e.g., flexible work environment, regular intern social connects, a buddy program, campus services such as fitness centre and canteen etc.

- A   customized personal development plan  including relevant coaching, mentorship, training-on-the-job, and a large portfolio of individual upskilling opportunities.

- The experience to be an integral part of our multi-functional teams of passionate and inspiring people with flat hierarchies to get to know the unique P&G culture.

- The chance to receive a full-time employment offer  to start after your studies with diverse career perspectives including new job assignments every 2-3 years to gain experience in different areas of Sales & Marketing.

- The option to combine your internship subsequently with your Bachelor / Master Thesis .

- Collaborate & manage multi-functional teams with international spirit, work with colleagues across regions and all levels.

As Influencer & Community Manager you’ll own end-to-end influencer partnerships, strategy and execution — from insight generation and talent selection to content delivery and performance optimisation — driving brand relevance, trust, and measurable impact across P&G’s portfolio.

Alongside this, you will also ensure these creator-led moments continue to live beyond campaigns, contributing to ongoing conversation, advocacy, and community engagement across platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Reddit.

We remain at the cutting edge of marketing with consumer behaviour at the heart of everything, constantly finding new ways to engage more people and develop campaigns that drive category growth and delight consumers.

Job Description

P&G Professional is pursuing a   $16 billion   professional cleaning market by serving the needs of professionals with trusted brands and superior products.

This role is the single point of ownership for digital commerce performance across P&G PRO North America , with   a strong foundation   across full funnel (awareness, consideration, and conversion) tactics.

The idea l   candidate   bring s   strong   expertise   in digital commerce, with hands-on experience in eContent optimization and search marketing,   alongside   a broad understanding of retailer media, digital merchandising, owned channels,   web analytics,   measurement, and emerging digital capabilities. This individual will   leverage   these capabilities to   identify   growth opportunities,   influence recommendations,   lead cross-functional initiatives, and   deliver measurable business results while   adapt ing   priorities based on evolving business and customer needs.

This is not an admin or process management role. It is a   strategic,   performance-driven digital commerce role with full end-to-end ownership of outcomes .   The successful candidate will   operate   comfortably in an evolving environment, helping define new ways of working,   identify   capability gaps, and shape how digital commerce is activated across the organization.

Scope of Responsibility

- Full-Funnel Digital Strategy:  Help shape digital commerce priorities across the full marketing funnel, including awareness, consideration, and conversion. Translate business goals into clear digital strategies that can flex across channels, customers, platforms, and evolving business needs.

- Customer & Channel Digital Growth:  Partner with customer teams, retailer partners, distributor partners, and internal stakeholders to identify   and recommend   digital growth opportunities across priority customers and   channels . Digital   Commerce Execution:  Lead and   execute   digital   growth initiatives   that may include eContent, digital shelf, paid search, retailer search, retailer media, social, email, digital merchandising, and other customer-facing digital tactics. Scope may flex   over time based on business priorities, customer needs, and where the greatest growth opportunities exist.

- Performance Measurement & Optimization:  Use digital performance data, customer insights, media results, content performance, and web analytics to   identify   opportunities,   optimize   plans, and improve the end-to-end digital customer journey. Connect activity across the funnel to measurable business outcomes.

- Agency, Platform & Partner Management:  Manage and influence external agencies, platform partners, and internal cross-functional teams to ensure digital work is clearly briefed, well-executed, measured effectively, and tied to business priorities. Provide strategic direction while   maintaining   accountability for execution and results.

- Digital Enablement & Capability Building:  Create scalable guidance, tools, best practices, and recommendations that help customer teams and internal partners better understand and activate digital opportunities. Support the organization in building stronger digital commerce capabilities over time.

- Test & Learn Leadership:   Identify   emerging digital opportunities, pilot new platforms, technologies, retailer capabilities, and measurement approaches to accelerate business growth. Recommend where successful initiatives should be scaled across the business.

Job Qualifications
Digital Commerce / eContent Expertise:  Demonstrated experience optimizing product content for digital retail, including Amazon, retailer .com sites, distributor websites, and digitally focused retailers. Understands how eContent drives conversion, organic search rank, digital shelf share, and downstream sales outcomes. Familiar with content management systems such as PIM, Syndigo, or equivalent platforms.
Search & Performance Marketing:  Hands-on experience managing paid search, retailer search, SEM, or PSOR programs — including keyword research, bid strategy, budget allocation, performance optimization, and conversion tracking. Understands CPC economics and how to drive cost-efficient click and conversion growth.
Retail Media & Digital Retailer Savvy:  Experience developing digital growth strategies across retailer media networks, marketplaces, distributor websites, and customer digital ecosystems. Understands how retailer media can support lower-funnel conversion while also flexing into mid-funnel and upper-funnel awareness or consideration tactics when appropriate.
Agency & Partner Management:  Proven ability to manage external agency partners across media, search, content, retail media, or digital commerce — setting briefs, reviewing performance, holding accountability for results, and translating business priorities into clear executional direction.
Analytical Rigor / Data Fluency:  Comfortable pulling, interpreting, and acting on digital performance data. Can connect dots across digital commerce and media performance including eContent, search, retailer media, web analytics, and customer insights to identify root causes and business opportunities. Experience with retail media dashboards, Google Ads, Pacvue, Amazon Ads, SEM Rush, or equivalent platforms preferred.
Executional Excellence:  Operational discipline with high attention to detail. P&G PRO has more products and complexity than traditional consumer brands — this person must successfully prioritize and manage multiple complex workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
Learning Agility & Adaptability:  Comfortable operating in an evolving business environment, learning new platforms and capabilities, and helping shape new ways of working as digital commerce continues to evolve.

- Delivery and start-up of new equipment, initiatives, and projects

- Controlling inventory via warehouse management systems & processes

- Managing timely shipping & receiving of customer orders and supply

- Ensuring freight capacity and reliable transportation of loads

P&G’s Fulfillment Centers work every day to assure supply of P&G products to our customers – it’s easy to see your direct impact on sales & company growth! Here are some examples of what our warehouse teams are working on:
•      Implementing cutting-edge automation technology (robotics, self-guided vehicles, and automated picking systems – just to name a few!)
•      Optimizing inventory flow to enable best-in-class customer service

•      Managing large teams of associates

We also have many roles in offices across the country – whether that be our Headquarters in Cincinnati, a Sales office located near one of our top customers, or an Innovation Center. These roles span across many areas of the supply chain, and could include:
- Forecasting customer demand

jobs.title: Senior Sailpoint Security Operations Analyst - Identity & Access Management
jobs.description:
Job Location
CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Identity & Privileged Access Operations Engineer to join the Information Security Identity and Access Management organization. This role will provide advanced operational support for SailPoint Identity Governance Administration services, while also supporting Privileged Access Management processes and platforms as part of the evolving IAM Operations model.

The role is intended for a hands-on operations professional who combines strong troubleshooting discipline, customer support mindset, ITIL-based incident and problem management, and practical IAM platform knowledge. SailPoint experience remains a core requirement, while PAM exposure and executive-care support are important extensions of the role.

The successful candidate will work closely with IAM Engineering, PAM platform owners, service management, ServiceNow / Help Desk teams, security operations partners, executive administrative support teams, and business users to resolve issues, improve service quality, strengthen operational controls, and mature a horizontal IAM Operations model.

A key expectation is to support the “onboard once, govern everywhere” direction: using consistent identity data, ownership, entitlement, and privileged-access signals across Sailpoint and PAM so customers are not asked to repeat separate onboarding and data-collection activities for every control plane.

Key Responsibilities:

SailPoint / Identity Governance Operations
- Provide advanced Level 3 operational support for SailPoint services.

- Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve access provisioning, identity lifecycle, certification, entitlement, role, workflow, policy, and data-quality related issues.

- Support complex incidents and problem records related to SailPoint IdentityIQ and associated IAM processes.

- Provide technical and operational guidance to Tier 2 Operations Analysts during incident management, problem management, change management, and operational escalations.

- Support access reviews, application onboarding / offboarding, identity lifecycle events, access provisioning, role management, rules, reports, password management, and operational tasks.

- Scripting, BeanShell, and Java understanding are preferred for troubleshooting and configuration analysis, but this is not intended to be a full developer role.

- Partner with IAM Engineering on platform defects, recurring issues, configuration issues, integration gaps, foundational connector concerns, and root-cause elimination.

Privileged Access Management Operations
- Support PAM operational processes and platforms, including privileged access issue resolution, account onboarding challenges, vaulting / privileged account governance, and control monitoring.

- Assist with privileged account lifecycle, privileged account ownership, compliance controls, audit readiness, risk signals, and service health activities.

- Partner with PAM platform owners and engineering teams to escalate and resolve complex privileged access issues.

- Connect Sailpoint and PAM support work by helping ensure privileged identities, accounts, entitlements, owners, applications, and governance attributes are consistently represented.

- Contribute to operational improvements that strengthen privileged access protection, reduce duplicate onboarding effort, and avoid parallel data-collection processes for customers.

Executive Care and Customer-Facing Support
- Provide direct L3 support for executive administrative teams when identity, access, or privileged access issues require high-touch resolution.

- Coordinate timely updates, escalation paths, and service restoration steps for executive-care scenarios while maintaining appropriate operational controls.

- Use executive-care insights to identify recurring pain points, process gaps, documentation needs, and automation opportunities.

Unified Onboarding and Governance
- Support a coverage model based on “onboard once, govern everywhere,” using shared identity, application, entitlement, ownership, and privileged-access data across IGA and PAM.

- Work with application owners, service managers, onboarding teams, data-quality resources, and platform owners to reduce separate onboarding asks and duplicate data grabs from customers.

- Help identify where PAM and Sailpoint overlap from a support perspective, including data model alignment, ownership validation, entitlement mapping, privileged flagging, and foundational connector or integration needs.

- Use support patterns and ticket data to feed continuous improvement across Sailpoint and PAM operational processes.

Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Management
- Manage incidents, service requests, problem records, and escalations through ServiceNow or similar workflow platforms.

- Lead or support root cause analysis for recurring or high-impact IAM / PAM issues.

- Participate in operational readiness, testing, validation, and change execution for IAM-related platform changes.

Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement
- Maintain and improve operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, knowledge articles, and support procedures.

- Identify recurring issue patterns and drive corrective actions to reduce ticket volume and improve service quality.

- Support operational metrics, KPIs, service reviews, health checks, and performance management.

- Contribute to automation, self-healing, workflow improvements, and process simplification.

- Help mature IAM Operations from reactive ticket resolution toward proactive service ownership and demand reduction.

Job Qualifications
Required:
- Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Software Engineering, other STEM field or 7+ years relevant years of experience/education.
- Strong experience in enterprise IT operations, IAM operations, cybersecurity support, or similar technical support environment.
- Hands-on experience supporting SailPoint IdentityIQ, SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, itAccess, or comparable IAM /Sailpoint platforms.
- Ability to read, understand, or troubleshoot Java / BeanShell scripts and SailPoint-related configuration; hands-on development is helpful but not required for this role.
- Strong understanding of IAM concepts, including identity lifecycle, access provisioning, access reviews, entitlements, roles, workflows, policy violations, and ownership models.
- Experience with ITIL-based incident, problem, change, and escalation management.
- Experience using ServiceNow or similar ticketing / workflow management platforms.
- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to coordinate effectively across Service Desk, Operations, Engineering, service managers, vendors, and business stakeholders.
- Strong customer service orientation and ability to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work hybrid schedule in Cincinnati, OH based office.

Preferred:
- Experience with Privileged Access Management platforms such as CyberArk, Delinea / Centrify, BeyondTrust, or similar.
- Knowledge of privileged account onboarding, vaulting, privilege elevation, session governance, privileged account ownership, and control monitoring.
- Experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ areas such as application onboarding / offboarding, certifications, tasks, reports, lifecycle events, workflows, rules, roles, access provisioning, and password management.
- Familiarity with connectors such as SAP, SAP Java, Oracle, Active Directory, Enterprise Directory, or similar.
- Familiarity with identity data models, entitlement mapping, application ownership, privileged account discovery, and governance metadata.
- Familiarity with cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
- Experience with server, database, Linux, Windows Server, or middleware operations.
- Scripting, automation, dashboarding, or data analysis capability.
- ITIL Foundation, SailPoint certification, PAM certification, cloud certification, or CISSP / cybersecurity certification preferred.

Job Description
About the Role

We are looking for a commercially minded and strategically driven Brand Communications & KOL Partnerships Manager to lead our influencer, creator, celebrity, and PR talent ecosystem end-to-end.

Sitting at the intersection of Category, Communications, and Purchasing , this role combines brand strategy, communications excellence, relationship management, reputation stewardship, and commercial negotiation to build high-impact partnerships that drive both brand growth and business results.

As the internal owner of KOL and PR talent partnerships, you will be responsible for building a sustainable creator ecosystem, managing strategic talent relationships, and ensuring all partnerships are aligned with brand objectives, governance standards, and reputation management requirements. You will also serve as a steward of brand reputation, ensuring every partnership strengthens brand equity, protects consumer trust, and meets the highest standards of compliance and responsible communications.

This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in both strategy and execution, and who understands that the most valuable partnerships are not simply the most visible, but the ones that create meaningful impact for consumers, brands, and business growth.

What You'll Own

KOL & Talent Strategy
- Develop and lead KOL, influencer, and talent strategies that support brand, communication, and business objectives.
- Identify, source, and cultivate relationships with relevant KOLs, creators, celebrities, agencies, and talent managers.
- Build and maintain a diverse and future-ready creator ecosystem aligned with brand growth ambitions.
- Stay ahead of emerging trends, talent movements, audience behaviors, and market dynamics within the influencer landscape.

End-to-End KOL Partnership Management
Own the complete KOL partnership lifecycle:
Identification → Evaluation → Outreach → Negotiation → Contracting → Briefing → Execution → Measurement → Optimization
- Lead talent selection and partnership development from concept through execution.
- Build long-term strategic relationships with key talent partners and agencies.
- Ensure every partnership delivers against communication objectives, commercial expectations, and brand standards.
- Establish scalable ways of working and governance processes across the KOL ecosystem.

Brand Reputation & Communications Stewardship
- Own brand reputation and brand safety across all influencer, creator, and talent partnerships.
- Evaluate and approve partnerships based on brand fit, audience quality, values alignment, and reputational risk.
- Ensure all KOL activities comply with brand guidelines, governance requirements, industry regulations, and responsible communication practices.
- Partner closely with Communications and Corporate Affairs teams to maintain alignment with reputation and stakeholder priorities.
- Lead risk monitoring, issue management, and cross-functional escalation processes to protect consumer trust and brand equity.

Commercial & Negotiation Leadership
- Lead negotiations with talent, agencies, and representatives, balancing relationship management with strong commercial discipline.
- Partner closely with Purchasing to secure competitive commercial terms and drive investment efficiency.
- Negotiate talent fees, deliverables, exclusivity requirements, content rights, usage rights, amplification opportunities, and partnership structures.
- Challenge proposals constructively to maximize value while maintaining strong and sustainable relationships.
- Drive governance, transparency, and accountability across all talent investments.

Cross-Functional Leadership
- Partner closely with Category teams to translate business priorities into talent and creator strategies.
- Collaborate with Communications teams to maximize earned, owned, and social-impact opportunities.
- Work with Purchasing teams to ensure commercial excellence, contracting compliance, and investment optimization.
- Act as the connective point between Category, Communications, and Purchasing to create a seamless and best-in-class KOL operating model.
- Influence senior stakeholders through insights, recommendations, and performance-driven decision making.

Execution, Measurement & Performance
- Lead campaign execution from briefing and content development through publishing, amplification, and campaign closeout.
- Define success metrics and establish performance frameworks across influencer partnerships.
- Track, evaluate, and optimize KOL performance, effectiveness, and ROI.
- Build robust evaluation models that assess: - Brand fit
- Audience quality
- Reach and influence
- Engagement
- Content effectiveness
- Business impact
- Commercial value

- Translate learnings into stronger partnership strategies and investment decisions.

Who We're Looking For
- Significant experience in Brand Communications, PR, Influencer Marketing, KOL Partnerships, Talent Management, Brand Reputation, or related fields.
- Deep understanding of the influencer, creator, and media landscape, with a strong network of industry relationships.
- Proven track record managing complex partnerships and negotiating high-value talent agreements.
- Strong commercial acumen with experience managing significant marketing or partnership investments.
- Experience working across multiple stakeholder groups, particularly Category, Communications, Procurement/Purchasing, and external agencies.
- Strong understanding of brand governance, reputation management, risk mitigation, and responsible communications.
- Highly relationship-oriented, with the confidence and influence to negotiate effectively and challenge constructively when required.
- Strategic thinker with exceptional executional rigor and attention to detail.
- Comfortable operating with autonomy while managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders.
- Analytical and performance-driven, leveraging data and insights to inform talent decisions and investment choices.

Job Qualifications
A communications leader with a commercial mindset, a strong industry network, and a passion for building partnerships that drive meaningful business and brand impact.
Someone who can serve as the organization's KOL and PR powerhouse —bringing together strategic thinking, reputation stewardship, relationship leadership, and commercial excellence to identify the right talent, secure the right partnerships, and deliver measurable results from start to finish.
Most importantly, someone who understands that great partnerships are not about who is the most famous , but who is the most credible, relevant, and impactful partner for the brand—and how to unlock maximum value from every relationship.

jobs.title: Purchasing Manager - Social Brand Building
jobs.description:
Job Location
BUCHAREST OFFICE
Job Description
Do you want to make an impact from Day 1 at a company behind some of the world’s most trusted consumer brands? At P&G, consumers are at the heart of everything we do. For more than 180 years, our people have combined leadership, innovation, and citizenship to improve everyday life in small but meaningful ways!

As Purchasing Manager for Social Brand Building , you will develop value-driven sourcing strategies, lead negotiations and contract management, and use market and performance insights to identify opportunities. You will manage a high-performing agency and supplier ecosystem, partner with Brand, Finance, Legal, and Operations to enable successful campaigns, ensure compliance, and drive scalable solutions, innovation, and measurable long-term business results.

💶 Monthly gross starting salary: 13.600 RON - this represents the starting salary for the role. We also recognize relevant experience and offer additional compensation accordingly. We consistently benchmark our salaries against top competitors and every P&G employee’s salary is reviewed at least annually so there is ample room for growth.

As a Purchasing Manager, you will be responsible for:
- Lead end-to-end strategic sourcing and contract governance for social marketing and agency partnerships, ensuring alignment with purchasing strategies, compliance, and best total value.

- Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external business partners to coordinate sourcing activities, manage statements of work and purchase orders, and ensure seamless, compliant campaign execution.

- Define and execute data-driven sourcing strategies, lead complex negotiations and supplier selection, and deliver total value creation through market analysis, cost modelling, and disciplined operational compliance.

- Own the full contract lifecycle—from drafting and negotiation to execution and compliance—while managing and improving agency and external partner performance across social marketing engagements.

- Develop and scale sourcing solutions, build cross-functional partnerships, and identify opportunities to improve marketing efficiency, enable campaign execution, and strengthen P&G’s position in the creator economy.

- Deliver excellent business results through rigorous execution, data-driven decision-making, disciplined compliance, and strategic relationship management to drive performance and value creation.
- Leverage a strong understanding of the social media, influencer, and creator ecosystem and cost models to shape sourcing strategies, evaluate agency and content creators capabilities, manage commercial models and enable compliant, effective creator partnerships.

Job Qualifications
Our ideal candidate profile:
- Minimum Bachelor’s Degree in Economics, Business Administration or Industrial engineering (a background in Marketing is a plus).
- Fluent business Romanian and English  proficiency (verbal and written).
- Relevant indirect procurement experience, particularly sourcing intangible services, with knowledge of the creator economy, social media, influencer marketing, agency models, and platform dynamics can represent an advantage.
- Understanding of digital risk management, including brand safety, data privacy (GDPR), and advertising standards.
- Strong analytical and commercial skills, including market analysis, cost modelling, savings tracking, business-case development, forecasting, and strategic decision-making.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and influencing skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across multifunctional teams and external partners.
- Demonstrated operational resilience and ability to drive processes effectively in complex environments.

Becoming part of P&G, you will benefit from:
- Competitive salary package, annual bonus and vacation bonus .
- Private medical insurance & life insurance & 24 Hours Accident Insurance .
- Stock Ownership Plan  - You have the opportunity to buy P&G shares quoted on the New York Stock Exchange to participate in the profits of the Company and the company will match part of the investments.
- Flexible working schedule & Hybrid Work from Home/Work from Office option.
- Meal allowance of 45 lei/worked day and access to our private canteen.
- Flex Benefits Fund  allows employees to customize their benefits according to their unique situations, aspirations, and life stages. You can allocate flexibly for your Mental, Financial, Physical, and Work-Life Wellbeing (e.g., sports, dental, public transportation support, cultural events, books & study materials, kids care expenses, pet care, etc).
- Access to a variety of learning and development internal platforms .
- Fresh fruits every day in the office.
- Purchase of company products option at reduced prices .
- Additional bridge days off offered by the company  (up to 3 days per year).
- Employee Assistance Program  – confidential expert guidance and specialist support on any work, wellbeing, emotional, financial, physical or family issue.

The above benefits are granted under the conditions of the collective labor agreement applicable, and P&G internal policies.

We produce globally recognized brands, and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including  Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more . We want you to inspire us with your unrivalled ideas.
